description: osirAgentResetPassword: Set a new dashboard password for the user's AI agent (e.g. Hermes) - 'I lost the password'. The old one stops working. The new password is in this result only: show it to the user once, in that reply. This is the ONLY way to change the agent's login. Requires authentication.

agentId.description: Agent id from osirAgentList or osirAgentDeploy.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAgentResetPassword
